title: Starfall Observatory Instruments — complete UI pitch
basePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity art-directed design-review board for the native portrait iPhone game STARFALL. Landscape board, approximately 1800x1200 or highest available resolution. This is a polished GAME interface, not a website. Use the provided approved concept as material/style reference. Refine it: midnight blue enamel; very fine antique brass edges, shallow machined bevel, small celestial star junctions; luminous pearl serif action labels with sharp readable interiors; simple clear sans serif for supporting text. Warm lantern light and violet/blue cloud world, tiny expressive faceted stars. Reduce gold rim weight and medallion bulk by half versus the reference. NO continuous neon rims, large rounded glass cards, generic dashboard, white web panels, currencies, XP, accounts, shops or extra gameplay systems. A consistent top-left warm light source. World fills each phone screen, UI respects a modest phone top camera safe area and bottom home area; edge controls are at these safe edges, never floating deep into center. Most fine details should be meaningful. All letters exceptionally crisp, no invented filler text. Screen content upright front-on with no physical phone bezel; clean straight portrait rectangles. Outside mock screens, use near-black navy art-board background and small neutral specimen captions. Header STARFALL / OBSERVATORY INSTRUMENTS and footer CONCEPT STUDY · NOT A BUILD. Do not shrink the screens to make room for long explanations. Use identical component styling across screens.
